reference_reuse.required_condition: New arms retain each matching protocol/target/seed source membership, loader, sampler, budget, optimizer/scheduler, common initialization, and checkpoint selection/target-freeze contract. Different preprocessed signals are deliberate only for phase arms. Reference code and metadata remain immutable.
reference_reuse.do_not_substitute: Factorial H10/H11 L124 references have a different TPP count; use sealed L1248 H10/H11 references recorded below.

training_contract.optimizer: torch.optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=.001, weight_decay=0), other arguments at PyTorch defaults
training_contract.scheduler: LambdaLR, step after every optimizer.step: lr after n updates=.001*.9**(n/10000); non-staircase. Update n uses pre-step lr=.001*.9**((n-1)/10000). Final post-update lr=.000729.
training_contract.precision: Historical inputs float64; feature-axis numpy.unwrap of historical phase before float32 loader conversion; ordinary float32 model, no AMP path in run_epoch.
training_contract.checkpoint_rule: Source validation accuracy; save on >= best, so last tied-best epoch. Patience=200 and strict break > patience ensure all 200 epochs.
training_contract.selection_folds: Source-only outer LOEO folds; no target-guided lambda/rule selection. H11 lambda=.05, temperature=.2, warmup=0 fixed historical values.
run_initialization_order: build frozen train, validation and diagnostic source-only test DataLoaders
iterate train loader then validation loader each epoch

sampler.algorithm: sorted domains; 16 items per source; build class pools in source-index order and Python-random shuffle each class pool each epoch; each batch random-shuffles class order per domain and takes classes round robin until 16; exhausted pools reshuffle; random-shuffle final 32-item batch. 150 batches per epoch.
sampler.rng: Continuous Python global RNG across epochs; do not reseed each epoch. Do not replace with R sampler or a custom torch generator. Preserve DataLoader iterator Torch RNG draws and constructor order.
sampler.schedule_digest: SHA256 of little-endian uint64 epoch numbers 1..200 followed by each batch global sample IDs as little-endian int64; global ID=ENV_ORDER index*3000+row_index.

training_contract.hybrid_forward_contract: Full B=32 forward first, then pseudo-Tx views [B,3,T,90] flattened to B*3=96 and encoded once; concatenate full projection then masked projections to [B,4,128]. Preserve ordering to retain MCAT BN and Dropout behavior. CE uses only full forward and lambda0 while retaining projection head parameters.

supcon.original_rule: global-global same class OR same-sample all views, then remove diagonal; all nonself pairs remain in denominator.
supcon.all_views_rule: all same-class views OR same-sample views, remove diagonal; directly supported by frozen dg_losses.
supcon.remove_instance_rule_note: Old include_same_domain_same_class=False only enforces cross-domain class positives and still ORs same-sample positives. It cannot implement remove-instance rule; new mask must exclude same-sample pairs explicitly and preserve denominator/valid-anchor averaging/eps1e-12.
supcon.batchnorm_note: MCAT uses BN; three separate masked forwards would change running statistics relative to historical B*3 call.

target_freeze: Load and hash source files only before source training
Use source-validation indices as historical diagnostic test split; discard this diagnostic
At all 200 epochs completion, save sampler ledger
Compute best_model.pt SHA256, instantiate fresh model and strict-load selected state
Write checkpoint_frozen.json with strict_load=true and target_data_opened=false
Only then first read/hash target amp/phase/label files and load target-only dataset
Evaluate ordered target predictions once, 3000 samples; seal completion and artifact hashes

H.source_split: Per source environment stratified 80/20 sample split; random_state=training_seed+original_environment_index+1; sorted global local index lists.
H.subject_disjointness: Not enforced by sample-stratified H; no claim of held-out subjects.

H-S.source_split: Frozen source_E*.json subject_grouped_holdout membership; fixed across every seed and arm. R manifest contributes identity membership only; retain H training and preprocessing.

historical_source_only_QA.what_was_matched: initial model state, model+Adam updates, Python and Torch RNG hashes, scheduler state/LR, actual accessed sample IDs for original and grouped adapter on real source inputs.

new_arm_count_plan.target_and_rule_tuning: Freeze all arm definitions/configuration before target evaluation, retain negative results and all seeds.

timing.source: UTC completion minus UTC start from sealed metadata only; includes training, target evaluation and posttrain runner validation, not queue delays. No scores used.
timing.caveat: Capacity model and native preprocessing arms may alter time; current runtime/hardware equivalence must be audited separately before treating these means as an ETA.

required_new_runner_QA: Verify exact code SHA/config bindings and immutable source membership/split hashes before launch.
Replay all 9 continuous sampler schedules separately for H and H-S and compare with matching stored references; no epoch reseeding.

For unchanged TPP/rule and phase arms verify initial full state hash matches seed reference; for capacity replacement retain identical common backbone tensors and restore RNG after extra control initialization, with explicit common-state/RNG audit.
Preserve historical masked B*3 encode, BN and Dropout sequence; exact original-rule source-only two-batch equivalence before introducing intended differences.
Test positive masks including identical sample IDs and remove-instance prohibition; denominator still all nonself projections.
Check 150/30000 steps, scheduler sequence, last tied-best source-accuracy checkpoint, fresh strict load and target-open guard.
Do not describe E1-E3 as historically untouched new environments: existing H-S config records prior target development.
